subject: Oversized binding_count fixed + NULL output sentinels; 776 checks
body: Fixed n2r_texture_resources_check: it now rejects !q or q->binding_count>TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_MAX_BINDINGS before touching q->bindings, before the sidecar/request scan and before gd_request_ok. n2r_texture_lookup also bounds count. New real tests in test_n2r_v2.c: q.binding_count=17 and UINT32_MAX with/without sidecar return -1 from n2r_validate/n2r_validate_v2/n2r_build_v2, and n2r_build_v2 leaves a 0x5a output packet byte-identical; the suite passes under ASan/UBSan with no OOB. NULL helper tests now also assert unchanged output sentinels for sampled/storage/plane/subresource. Helper release+ASan/UBSan 776 checks PASS; n2r suite all eight lines PASS both modes. Current shas: header/n2r may move only if further findings arrive. Remaining cross-owner unchanged: compute bridge D2_OFFSET/whole-BO span and swizzle_valid/view-format; render fixed/compositor legacy sampler guards; exact factory enable before first creation. No phone/build/commit/publish.
